name: limit-alerts
description: Warns before a Claude subscription usage limit runs out: hook messages, macOS notifications, a limits-aware statusline and a /compact advisor.

lang.title: Notification language
lang.description: ru or en. Applies to hook messages, macOS banners and the statusline.

warn.title: Warning threshold
warn.description: Percent of a limit at which the first warning is sent.

crit.title: Critical threshold
crit.description: Percent of a limit at which the critical warning is sent.

attention.title: "Needs your attention" notifications
attention.description: macOS banner and sound when Claude waits for an answer or finishes a turn.

compact_advisor.title: /compact advisor
compact_advisor.description: Suggests running /compact at a logical breakpoint when the context window fills up.

statusline.title: Limits in the statusline
statusline.description: Writes statusLine into ~/.claude/settings.json, preserving any existing statusline. Off by default because it edits a file outside the plugin.

launchd.title: Background agent (launchd)
launchd.description: Checks limits every 5 minutes so window-reset notifications arrive while Claude Code is closed. Off by default because it registers a system agent.
